$Comment: The wide bar panel in the top-right, for values that move while a player is out in the world
with no ledger for them to sit beside. Which panel a row lands on is decided by the mod
reporting the movement, so a value only appears here if that mod put it here.
It sits above the quest tracker so the top-right column reads as one thing, and because it is
pinned to the right edge it grows LEFTWARD as columns open, keeping its first column where your
eye already is. Both panels are sized by their contents, so if a busy stretch of yours brings
the two close together, move one: Position is a corner preset (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight,
CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight) plus pixel offsets from
the edges that preset pins.
RowsPerColumn is 1 here, so a second row opens a second column instead of stacking underneath:
one moving value draws a single bar, and the panel grows sideways to six columns before it
grows downward at all. That is deliberate: growing sideways keeps it clear of the quest tracker
below, which growing downward would eventually reach. Set RowsPerColumn higher to stack first
and spread later, or set Columns to 1 for a plain vertical list. MaxVisible is unstated, so
every slot the panel has is available.
RepaintMs is how often the panel redraws at most. A movement redraws immediately when the last
redraw is already that old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end, so a number on
screen is never left waiting on a later movement to bring it up to date.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Grid' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-panels.json with only the leaves you want different. Set Enabled to
false there to switch this whole panel off.
